citations.claim: Cart left the track at the first violating step, x beyond -2.4
Cart already near the track end 6 steps before violation, drifting negative
Cart started offset negative and drifted steadily outward while pole stayed balanced

counterfactual.change: Changed only initial.x from -0.3548 to 0.0; centered cart no longer drifts off track in 181 steps, so failure is caused by uncorrected cart drift not pole fall.

explanation: State-feedback controller keeps pole balanced (theta ~ -0.08 at step 181, margin 0.72) but applies only small force (~0.77N vs 46N limit) and lets cart velocity stay negative (~-1.3 m/s), so initial offset -0.35m drifts steadily to -2.41m beyond track. Cause is likely pole-priority regulation with weak cart-position feedback for this plant.

violation.detail: cart at x=-2.412 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: The cart is at the far left edge of the track with the pole still nearly upright. From steps 178 to 181 it drifts slightly further left without the pole falling.
